title: Analysts lean positive for the Diwali hour

timeline.title: Analysts lean positive for the Diwali hour
timeline.line: Sensex and Nifty rose in eight of the last 10 Muhurat sessions, per Business Standard
more: One analyst expects a gap-up open, then a narrow range into the close
Master Capital's Ravi Singh: the hour should not be read as confirming a sustained rally
Comes after what reports call the biggest pre-Diwali rally in 35 years
